pattern: となると / となれば
purpose: Consider the consequences once a situation becomes real or definite.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
N / plain clause + となると / となれば / となったら
If we are actually going to relocate, there is much to prepare.
If everyone is attending, we will need a large venue.
Once it came to giving the presentation myself, I suddenly got nervous.
formation: N / plain clause + となると / となれば / となったら
restrictions: Often contrasts a general idea with its practical implementation.
mistake: It foregrounds a newly relevant situation, not just any condition.
